Need help finding a provider?

Get care now

When you can’t wait to see a provider, Atrium Health’s on-demand care options allow you to get the care you need quickly, no appointment required:

  • Urgent care: Get in-person care for unexpected illnesses and minor injuries. Find an urgent care near you.
  • Emergency care: For serious medical emergencies, our emergency rooms are open 24/7 and staffed by providers board-certified in emergency medicine. Find the nearest emergency care.
  • Virtual Visit: Have a secure, face-to-face video chat with a trusted healthcare provider. ​Available 24/7 for all ages. Log in to MyAtriumHealth to start a visit or learn more here.
  • eVisit: Get care through a secure message any time of day or night. Log in to MyAtriumHealth to get started, or find out more here.
  • COVID-19: Looking for information about COVID-19 and where to get care? Visit here.

Talk to an Atrium Health representative

We’re here to connect you with expert care. To get help finding the right provider for you, call 800-323-8622.

If your symptoms are life-threatening, call 911 immediately.
